messages:
jamie: Hey team — PR #4132 turned red on the nightly matrix after merge. Only the linux-integration and smoke-matrix axes failed, looks like test flakes. Can we retrigger just those without rebuilding the image? (don't want to waste build minutes)
ci-bot: Build results: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/infra/pipelines/123/runs/4567
ci-bot: Failed slices: linux-integration (slice_id=mx-789), smoke-matrix (slice_id=sm-012)
michael: You can re-run slices via the CLI:
```
redwood-ci rerun --pr 4132 --slices mx-789,sm-012 --skip-imagebuild
```
that preserves the previously built image+artifacts.
sasha: Alternatively add a GH comment: `/ci rerun --slices mx-789,sm-012 --no-build` — automation will pick it up.
jamie: perfect — any caveats? will it preserve DB fixtures and kv-cache?
taylor: It preserves workspace artifacts and docker image; if the job depends on a fresh DB snapshot you'll need `--fresh-db`, otherwise it's same env as original run.
jamie: ok running the CLI now. will ping when green. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Triggered rerun 2187654321-2 for slices mx-789,sm-012 — link: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/2187654321-2
michael: If it still flakes, we can bisect tests with `redwood-ci bisect --slice mx-789 --test jasmine/foo.spec`.
